lifetime: Mux snapshots STREAMINFO and comment entries before first await. Packet iterables are one-shot; chunks are consumed and released before advancing. Caller retains source/demux lifetime. Mux commits on success and aborts on failure; use an output-group writer to defer actual atomic publication. Backend closes demux in finally and owns its transaction.
memory: Core reservation accounts metadata snapshots and 34-byte extradata; one allocate(min(maxWriteBytes,65536)) staging buffer. Backpressured sequential writes; staging stays reserved until any in-flight late write settles after abort. No complete input or packet buffering; provider/runtime buffers remain outside owned accounting.
semantics: Packet bytes and original STREAMINFO (including total samples and MD5 for finite frame limits) preserved. Native vendor/software tags, Vorbis metadata key conversion, default 8192-byte padding. Explicit metadata mapping and overrides, bitexact, frame limits, overwrite policy and stream selection supported.
unsupported: Re-encoding, seeking, filters, side-data extradata updates, duplicate audio maps, arbitrary stream metadata options
integration: Root dispatcher integration and package-barrel imports are present. Focused public remux tests exercise the actual createMediaBackend route; combined Workers tests exercise public dispatch on actual R2/workerd without Node production dependencies. Native file-protocol -blocksize is represented by provider short reads, not supported as a virtual-backend CLI option.
